payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-26 (offline triage against main c417e7b1c, session claude/urgent-ledger-fixes-8dnh5c): npm audit on the installed lockfile reports 0 vulnerabilities across 991 packages (prod and dev). pip-audit --no-deps over the three Python lockfiles finds two advisories, both without a fixed release: nltk 3.10.3 PYSEC-2026-3740 in worker/python/requirements.txt and requirements-cloud.txt (already accepted above: the worker never calls the affected function), and accelerate 1.14.0 PYSEC-2026-3804 in eval/docling/requirements.txt, which is an offline evaluation image that is never deployed to Railway, so not reachable from psychiatry.tools. So no reachable, fixable advisory remains in the app or worker lockfiles. GitHub's push message on 2026-09-26 now reports 3 open Dependabot alerts on main (2 high, 1 moderate), down from 22 (2 critical, 11 high); the two Python advisories above plausibly account for two of them. NOT CHECKED: which three alerts they are (the cloud GitHub token gets HTTP 403 on the Dependabot alerts endpoint), GitHub Actions advisories and container base images. Five open Dependabot bump PRs (#2949 to #2953) cover npm prod, npm dev, Actions and both Python groups. Close condition: the owner reads the Dependabot security tab once (github.com/BigSimmo/Database/security/dependabot) and confirms nothing open is outside the two accepted Python advisories. PRIOR DETAIL: UPDATE 2026-09-25 (PR #3021, offline): partial fix. js-yaml bumped to 4.3.2 in package-lock.json (dev-only advisory closed) and the Python worker's nltk pinned to 3.10.3 via pip-tools --upgrade-package. PYSEC-2026-3740 has no fixed release; the vulnerable code path is not reached by the worker (it does not call the affected function), so it is accepted until upstream ships a fix. Remaining: re-read the live Dependabot list after this merges and triage anything still open. PRIOR DETAIL: REVIEW 2026-09-25 (offline audit of current main; no provider access): npm audit needs the network, so not re-verified. Lockfiles changed since 2026-09-20 (sharp added c8e21b074; Python cloud lock regenerated dde0a3df4), so the 22 / 2 critical / 11 high counts may have moved; re-read the Dependabot list before triage. PRIOR DETAIL: Triage the Dependabot list and record, per advisory, whether it is reachable from the live site or confined to build/dev tooling. Why: 2 critical and 11 high are reported on the default branch and nobody has looked; npm audit alone does NOT see them — it found only one dev-only js-yaml advisory, so the earlier 'one low-priority issue' read was wrong. Dependabot also covers the Python worker, container images and Actions. Context: reported on every git push during the 2026-09-19 review. Owner: assistant to triage, user to approve any bump. Confidence: high — the counts come from GitHub's own push message. Depends on: nothing.
